English Proficiency Requirements
English proficiency Requirements
Rutgers-Camden encourages international students to apply to our community. If you completed your secondary education in a country where English is not the primary language, English proficiency exams are a necessary requirement. For information on exemption criteria and the list of approved tests, please refer to the provided instructions. We look forward to receiving your application and assisting you.
TAKE THE NEXT STEP
Apply Today
Graduate Programs
Contact Us
Request Info
Office of International Students
Required Credentials for International Applicants
Regardless of U.S. residency status, an English proficiency examination is required of all students whose secondary schooling has been outside the U.S. in a country where English is not the principal language. Score reports must be from tests taken within the past two years and submitted directly to us from the testing service.
Exemptions
English language scores are not required for applicants when applicants have been:
Awarded a Degree from an English-Instruction Institution
Awarded a Degree from a U.S. Regionally Accredited Institution
Awarded a Degree in an English Speaking Country
If any of the aforementioned situations apply to your case, kindly alert us at camgrad@rutgers.edu.
Acceptable English Proficiency Tests
Rutgers accepts several standardized tests to determine the English proficiency of its international applicants, with the full list available below. For programs requiring the GRE, currently limited to select PhD programs, detailed information can be found on the individual program pages.
Test
Score
TOEFL IBT & IBT Home Edition
The Rutgers Code is 2790
4.5*
IELTS Academic
Choose: Rutgers University Undergraduate and Graduate Programs
6.5
Michigan English Test (MET) 4-Skill Test
56
Pearson PTE Academic
53
Duolingo English Test
120
*For TOEFL exams taken through January 21, 2026, the minimum requirements are Writing 22, Speaking 23, Reading 21, and Listening 17.
Need Assistance, We’re Here to Help
We understand that this can be a complex process, and we want to assure you that our dedicated team is here to provide the support you need. If you have any questions or require additional assistance, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us. We are always available to help.
